review_rules: Orsimer origin accounts involving Trinimac, Boethiah and Malacath remain religious/mythic traditions with source-specific provenance
Do not treat Orc stronghold customs as universal to every Orsimer community, city or historical period
Different incarnations of Orsinium must be modeled as historically distinct settlements/polities linked by name and tradition
The Code of Malacath should distinguish prescriptive religious/legal ideals from observed practice
Outsider descriptions of Orcs retain authorial bias metadata and must not override Orc self-description
Cross-link existing Orsimer, Orsinium, Wrothgar, Malacath, Trinimac, Boethiah, First Orsinium, Ranser's War and Gortwog records
